items.description: Tete Community Park is a green gathering space for locals, offering playgrounds and recreational areas.
Inchope provides crucial wildlife corridors and habitats, essential for the migration of various animal species.
Chimoio Green Life is a project promoting sustainable agriculture and environmental education for children.
Vilankulo Marine serves as the gateway to the Bazaruto Archipelago, renowned for its diving and snorkeling sites.
Inhambane offers historical architecture and access to beautiful beaches and diverse dive sites.
Gaza Farm is an agricultural project aimed at fostering local development and providing food security.
Cabo Delgado province is known for its mango cultivation, a significant contributor to the local economy.
Tete Agri Project is an initiative focused on agricultural development and food security in the Tete region.
Lake Niassa, also known as Lake Malawi, is one of Africa's largest and deepest lakes, with rich fish diversity.
Gorongosa Mountain is part of Gorongosa National Park, offering diverse flora and fauna at various altitudes.
The Limpopo River is a major river in Southern Africa, flowing through Mozambique and forming a vital ecosystem.
The Primeiras and Segundas Islands are a protected archipelago with pristine coral reefs and mangrove forests.
Maputo Bay is a large natural harbor, home to diverse marine life and important for local fisheries.
Quirimbas Archipelago is a national park of 32 islands, known for its pristine beauty and marine biodiversity.
Romué Mountain is a prominent peak in Manica Province, harboring rich vegetation and rare bird species.
